title: THE LAST FRAME
visual_style: Gritty realism with a touch of sci-fi surrealism, emphasizing tension and psychological unease.
cinematography_strategy: Use a mix of controlled, static shots for character focus and handheld, dynamic shots to convey urgency and unpredictability. Emphasize close-ups for character emotions and screen content. Leverage natural light where possible, augmented by artificial sources to create dramatic contrast and reinforce the mood. Utilize shallow depth of field to isolate subjects and draw attention to critical details, particularly screen displays.

scenes.source_scene_summary: Freelance filmmaker Maya discovers her camera recording a video from her future self, warning her about an event tomorrow and telling her not to trust Daniel.
scenes.visual_goal: Establish Maya's everyday life before the intrusion, then build tension and mystery as she encounters the impossible video from her future self. Clearly delineate between present reality and recorded footage.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Freelance filmmaker Maya discovers her camera recording a video from her future self...
shots.subject: MAYA
shots.action: Maya is engrossed in editing footage on her monitors, an old digital camera resting nearby.
shots.visual_description: Maya, 27, focused and illuminated by the glow of multiple computer monitors. Her apartment is cluttered but organized, reflecting a creative professional. An old, clunky digital camera sits on her desk, seemingly inert.
shots.lighting: Dim, ambient apartment lighting, with strong practical light sources from monitors creating blue/white hues on Maya's face.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic composition, medium shot of Maya Sen, 27, engrossed in editing on multiple computer monitors in her dimly lit apartment. An old digital camera is visible on her cluttered wooden desk. The monitors cast a cool, blue-white light on her face, creating strong shadows in the room. Shallow depth of field, focused on Maya. Gritty realism, film grain, digital photography look. Moody, introspective atmosphere.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...camera recording a video from her future self, warning her about an event tomorrow...
shots.subject: OLD DIGITAL CAMERA SCREEN
shots.action: The old digital camera's screen flickers to life, displaying cryptic text.
shots.visual_description: The small, pixelated screen of the old digital camera illuminates. Green block text appears: 'TOMORROW, 11:47 PM.' The camera body is worn and slightly dated.
shots.lighting: The camera screen emits a bright, eerie green light, contrasting with the dim background.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: 'TOMORROW, 11:47 PM.' text on camera display. Ensure realistic pixelation and glow.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up shot, low angle, focused on the small, pixelated screen of an old, worn digital camera. The screen glows an eerie, bright green, displaying crisp, blocky text: 'TOMORROW, 11:47 PM.' The background is out of focus, dark, hinting at a cluttered apartment. Gritty realism, strong contrast, sci-fi thriller aesthetic. Emphasize the glow of the screen.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Maya discovers her camera recording...
shots.subject: MAYA
shots.action: Maya reacts with surprise and concern, picking up the camera.
shots.visual_description: Maya's face, initially confused, shifts to concern as she slowly reaches for and picks up the camera, her reflection subtly visible in its screen.
shots.lighting: The green glow from the camera screen illuminates Maya's face from below, creating an unnatural, investigative light.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, push-in shot of Maya Sen's face. Her expression transitions from mild confusion to apprehension. A subtle green glow from the old digital camera she's holding or picking up casts eerie light upwards on her features. Shallow depth of field, background blurred. Gritty realism, high detail on facial expression. Intense, questioning mood.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Implied action after the camera records, leading to playback.
shots.subject: LAPTOP SCREEN
shots.action: A new video file, 'LAST FRAME.MOV', appears on Maya's laptop desktop.
shots.visual_description: Maya's laptop screen displays a standard desktop, then a new file icon materializes: 'LAST FRAME.MOV'. The file appears suddenly, as if uploaded from the camera.
shots.lighting: The bright, consistent backlight of the laptop screen. The surrounding area is slightly darker, drawing focus to the screen.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: 'LAST FRAME.MOV' video file appearing on laptop desktop.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, high angle shot of a laptop screen. The screen displays a clean, dark desktop background. Suddenly, a file icon labeled 'LAST FRAME.MOV' appears on the desktop. The screen has a realistic glow, reflecting faintly on the keyboard below. Gritty realism, digital interface aesthetic, focusing on the unexpected appearance of the file.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Playback of 'FUTURE MAYA' footage with altered apartment environment (darker, overturned furniture, shattered window) from VFX requirements. ...video from her future self, warning her about an event tomorrow and telling her not to trust Daniel.
shots.subject: FUTURE MAYA (ON LAPTOP SCREEN)
shots.action: Future Maya, exhausted and terrified, appears on the laptop screen, speaking urgently.
shots.visual_description: The laptop screen fills with the face of Future Maya (27, but looking haggard). She is in a darkened, damaged apartment with overturned furniture and a shattered window visible behind her in the video footage. She speaks directly into the camera within the footage, her eyes wide with fear.
shots.lighting: Within the screen footage: dim, inconsistent light, possibly from a flickering source, casting harsh shadows on Future Maya's face. The laptop screen itself emits a cool, blue light.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: Playback of 'FUTURE MAYA' footage. Footage shows Future Maya in a darker, overturned, damaged apartment with a shattered window. Ensure the video quality looks like recorded camera footage.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic extreme close-up, eye-level shot focused entirely on a laptop screen displaying a video of FUTURE MAYA. She is 27, but looks gaunt, terrified, and exhausted. Her face is illuminated by flickering, harsh, low-key light within the video. In the background of the video, Maya's apartment is visibly damaged, with overturned furniture and a shattered window. The video quality has a raw, recorded, slightly grainy look. Gritty realism, intense fear, desperate urgency.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...telling her not to trust Daniel. 'Apartment lights flickering' from VFX.
shots.subject: FUTURE MAYA (ON LAPTOP SCREEN)
shots.action: Future Maya delivers a stark warning about Daniel, and the lights in her recorded apartment flicker erratically.
shots.visual_description: Future Maya's face on the laptop screen, her voice strained. Behind her, within the footage, the apartment lights flicker violently, enhancing the sense of dread and instability.
shots.lighting: Within the screen footage: the flickering lights create rapid shifts between bright illumination and deep shadow on Future Maya's face and the background.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: Playback of 'FUTURE MAYA' footage. Ensure apartment lights flicker within the recorded footage, adding to the visual distress.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, eye-level shot of FUTURE MAYA's face on a laptop screen. Her expression is one of extreme paranoia and dread. In the recorded footage playing on the screen, the apartment lights behind her flicker violently and erratically, casting dramatic, shifting shadows on her face. The image is grainy, raw, as if recorded by a shaky hand-held camera. Gritty realism, intense atmosphere of danger.

shots.screenplay_evidence: 'Figure appearing behind Maya in camera footage' from VFX.
shots.subject: FUTURE MAYA AND FIGURE (ON LAPTOP SCREEN)
shots.action: A shadowy figure emerges silently behind Future Maya in the recorded video, startling her.
shots.visual_description: The laptop screen shows Future Maya, distracted and turning her head slightly, as a dark, indistinct figure materializes from the shadows behind her within the footage. Her eyes widen in terror.
shots.lighting: Within the screen footage: poor, shadowy lighting, making the figure ambiguous and menacing. Only partial outlines are visible.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: Playback of 'FUTURE MAYA' footage. Composited shadowy figure appearing behind Future Maya in the recorded video. The figure should be ambiguous, only partially seen.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic medium shot, eye-level, focusing on the laptop screen. The screen displays recorded footage of FUTURE MAYA, who is turning with a terrified expression. Behind her, a tall, dark, indistinct figure with ambiguous features appears out of deep shadows within the recorded video. The lighting within the video is low-key, adding to the suspense. Gritty realism, horror, psychological thriller.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Implied reaction to the shocking content.
shots.subject: MAYA
shots.action: Maya recoils from the laptop, her face a mask of shock and terror.
shots.visual_description: Maya pulls back abruptly from the laptop, her hands perhaps flying up slightly. Her eyes are wide with disbelief and fear, reflected by the flickering screen light. The laptop's glow quickly leaves her face as she pulls back.
shots.lighting: The laptop's cool, blue light briefly illuminates Maya's shocked face, then recedes as she pulls back, leaving her in relative darkness.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, pull back shot of Maya Sen. Her face is a mask of pure shock and terror, eyes wide and fixed. She recoils abruptly from the laptop, moving back into the apartment's dim lighting. The blue light from the screen quickly fades from her face as she moves. Gritty realism, intense emotional portrayal, unsettling atmosphere.

scenes.source_scene_summary: After seeing the video, Maya receives a message and call from Daniel, who also claims to have seen the video and warns her to destroy the camera, as the apartment lights flicker and the camera begins recording again.
scenes.visual_goal: Show Maya's escalating anxiety and the inexplicable nature of the events. Build suspense as the threats from the video manifest in her present reality.

shots.screenplay_evidence: After seeing the video, Maya receives a message...
shots.subject: MAYA AND PHONE
shots.action: Maya sits in her apartment, visibly shaken, when her phone vibrates.
shots.visual_description: Maya is slumped on her couch or at her desk, still in a state of distress from the video. Her phone buzzes loudly on a nearby surface, startling her.
shots.lighting: Dim, tense apartment lighting. A single, focused practical lamp might highlight Maya's solitude and anxiety.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic medium shot, eye level, of Maya Sen slumped on a couch in her dimly lit apartment. She looks anxious and isolated, grappling with fear. Her smartphone vibrates loudly on a small table beside her. The lighting is low-key, with a single lamp casting warm light, creating a moody, tense atmosphere. Gritty realism, emotional depth.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...receives a message and call from Daniel...
shots.subject: PHONE SCREEN
shots.action: The phone screen displays a new message from 'DANIEL'.
shots.visual_description: The phone screen illuminates, showing a text message notification from a contact named 'DANIEL'. The content of the message is partially obscured but looks urgent.
shots.lighting: Bright, even illumination from the phone screen itself.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: Text message notification from 'DANIEL'.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, top-down shot of a smartphone screen. The screen is illuminated, displaying a new text message notification from 'DANIEL'. The content is partially visible, hinting at urgency. The background is a blurred, dark surface. Gritty realism, digital interface, conveying an immediate, intrusive message.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...and call from Daniel...
shots.subject: MAYA AND PHONE
shots.action: Maya answers the incoming call from Daniel, her apprehension palpable.
shots.visual_description: Maya picks up the ringing phone, the contact name 'DANIEL' visible on the screen. Her expression is a mix of dread and reluctant curiosity as she brings it to her ear.
shots.lighting: Soft, muted light, emphasizing the internal conflict on Maya's face.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, eye-level shot of Maya Sen. She holds a smartphone to her ear, the screen faintly displaying 'DANIEL'. Her expression is a complex mix of dread, apprehension, and cautious curiosity. Soft, muted lighting highlights her conflicted emotions. Gritty realism, psychological tension.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...who also claims to have seen the video and warns her to destroy the camera...
shots.subject: MAYA
shots.action: Maya listens intently, her expression hardening as Daniel relays his urgent warning.
shots.visual_description: Over Maya's shoulder, focusing on her face. Her eyes are wide with shock and confusion as Daniel's words sink in, particularly his warning to destroy the camera. We only hear Daniel's voice.
shots.lighting: Harsh, focused light from above, casting shadows that emphasize Maya's growing alarm.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, over-the-shoulder shot (from behind Maya's shoulder, looking at her face). Maya Sen listens to her phone, her eyes wide with shock and confusion. Her expression hardens into alarm as Daniel's voice (implied) delivers an urgent warning. Harsh, focused overhead lighting creates dramatic shadows. Gritty realism, psychological intensity.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...as the apartment lights flicker...
shots.subject: MAYA'S APARTMENT
shots.action: The lights in Maya's apartment begin to flicker erratically.
shots.visual_description: A wide shot of Maya's apartment, with Maya still holding the phone to her ear. The overhead lights in the apartment begin to flicker violently, momentarily plunging areas into darkness before returning. The atmosphere becomes unstable.
shots.lighting: The main apartment lights visibly flicker, causing rapid changes in illumination and shadow throughout the room, creating an unsettling strobe effect.
shots.vfx_notes: Practical lighting effect of flickering lights, potentially enhanced with VFX for intensity and randomness. Ensure the flickering is jarring.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic wide shot, eye-level, of Maya Sen's apartment. Maya stands (or sits) holding her phone. The overhead lights in the entire apartment visibly flicker and buzz erratically, casting dynamic, unsettling shadows that shift rapidly. The atmosphere is unstable and chaotic. Gritty realism, supernatural horror, psychological dread.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...and the camera begins recording again.
shots.subject: OLD DIGITAL CAMERA
shots.action: The old digital camera, unattended, activates and displays 'RECORDING.'
shots.visual_description: The old digital camera, lying innocently on the desk, suddenly turns itself on. Its small screen glows red, and the word 'RECORDING.' flashes, indicating autonomous operation.
shots.lighting: The camera's red screen glow is the dominant light source, cutting through the dim apartment light. Surrounding area is dark and out of focus.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: 'RECORDING.' text with a red flashing indicator on the camera display.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, eye-level shot of an old digital camera resting on a dark desk. The camera's small screen suddenly illuminates with a bright red glow, displaying the word 'RECORDING.' with a flashing indicator. The surrounding area is dark and out of focus. Gritty realism, ominous, self-activating technology.

scenes.source_scene_summary: Maya waits at a train station at 11:46 PM, camera recording, seeing a figure in its footage. Daniel is on the train and urges her to get off as the camera shows a derailing, and she complies, updating the timeline.
scenes.visual_goal: Heighten the stakes and bring the futuristic threat into the present. Capture the chaos and urgency of a train station while focusing on Maya's personal horror and decision-making. Make the train derailing a purely visual effect on a screen to preserve the media boundary.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Maya waits at a train station at 11:46 PM...
shots.subject: MAYA, TRAIN STATION PLATFORM
shots.action: Maya stands alone on a deserted train station platform, looking apprehensive.
shots.visual_description: A sprawling, dimly lit train station platform. The air is cold and misty. Maya is a small, isolated figure against the imposing architecture. The platform clock reads '11:46 PM'.
shots.lighting: Harsh, industrial overhead lights casting long shadows. A cold, blue-ish tint to the ambient light, emphasizing the late hour.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic wide shot, high angle, crane shot pulling out slowly, revealing a vast, deserted train station platform at night. Maya Sen is a small, solitary figure standing near the tracks. Harsh, industrial overhead lights cast long, stark shadows. The air is misty and cold, with a blue-ish tint to the overall lighting. A large clock on the platform wall prominently displays '11:46 PM'. Gritty realism, tense, isolated atmosphere.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Maya waits at a train station at 11:46 PM, camera recording...
shots.subject: OLD DIGITAL CAMERA SCREEN
shots.action: The old digital camera's screen displays the current time and 'RECORDING.'
shots.visual_description: The camera screen shows '11:46 PM' and the red 'RECORDING.' indicator. The background is a blurred glimpse of the train tracks.
shots.lighting: The bright, digital glow of the camera screen, contrasting with the dark, blurred background.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: '11:46 PM' and 'RECORDING.' text on camera display.

The background is an out-of-focus blur of dark train tracks and dimly lit station architecture. Gritty realism, stark digital display, unsettling.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...seeing a figure in its footage.

shots.action: Maya looks at the camera screen and sees a fleeting, shadowy figure behind her in the live footage.
shots.visual_description: The shot mimics Maya's POV looking at the camera screen: the live feed of the empty platform. For a split second, a dark, ambiguous figure is visible far behind her in the footage, then it vanishes as if an artifact.
shots.lighting: Within the screen footage: the dim, artificial lights of the station, with deep shadows where the figure briefly appears.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: Live camera feed of the train station platform. Composited shadowy figure appearing briefly in the background of the live feed, then disappearing. The figure should be vague and unsettling.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic point-of-view shot, appearing as if seen through a camera screen, showing the train station platform. The image has a slight handheld shimmer. For a fleeting moment, a dark, ambiguous figure appears in the far background of the camera feed, partially obscured by shadows, then is gone. The lighting within the 'feed' is artificial and cold. Gritty realism, unsettling, a momentary phantom.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Daniel is on the train...
shots.subject: TRAIN, DANIEL
shots.action: A train powerfully pulls into the station, and Daniel is seen frantically looking out a window.
shots.visual_description: A long, sleek train thunders into the station, its bright headlights momentarily blinding. As it slows, Daniel's face is seen through one of the windows, looking urgent and desperate towards Maya.
shots.lighting: The bright, harsh headlights of the train against the dark station. Interior train lights illuminate Daniel. Steam and brake sparks momentarily add drama.

Daniel's face is visible through one of the train windows, looking urgent and desperate. Steam billows around the train's wheels, and brake sparks fly. Gritty realism, industrial, high energy.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...urges her to get off...
shots.subject: DANIEL
shots.action: Daniel, behind the train window, urgently mouths words or gestures towards Maya.
shots.visual_description: Close up on Daniel's face pressed against the train window. He is shouting, perhaps hitting the glass, trying desperately to convey a message to Maya over the din of the station.
shots.lighting: Harsh, interior train lighting on Daniel's face, making his desperation clear. Reflections on the window add visual complexity.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up, eye-level shot of Daniel's face. He is pressed against a train window, his expression frantic and desperate, shouting and gesturing towards someone off-screen. Reflections of the station lights are visible on the glass. Harsh, cool interior train lighting. Gritty realism, intense urgency.

shots.screenplay_evidence: Implied reaction to Daniel's urgency.
shots.subject: MAYA
shots.action: Maya looks from Daniel to her camera, agonizing over a decision.
shots.visual_description: Maya, frozen for a moment, her eyes darting between Daniel's desperate face in the train window and the small screen of her recording camera, held tight in her hand. Her dilemma is clear.
shots.lighting: Intermittent light from the train passing, mixed with static station lights, creating a flickering, uncertain mood on Maya's face.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic medium shot, eye-level, with a quick pan between subjects. Maya Sen's face is fraught with conflict and agony. Her eyes dart from an unseen Daniel in the train window to the small, recording digital camera clutched tightly in her hand. Intermittent, flickering light from the train and station illuminates her face, enhancing the drama. Gritty realism, intense psychological tension.

shots.screenplay_evidence: ...as the camera shows a derailing...
shots.subject: OLD DIGITAL CAMERA SCREEN (DERAILING FOOTAGE)
shots.action: The old digital camera's screen abruptly displays horrifying footage of a train derailing.
shots.visual_description: The camera screen fills with violent, chaotic imagery: a train violently derailing, metal screeching, sparks flying, carriages flipping and crashing. The footage is raw, digital, and intensely disturbing, as if from a security camera.
shots.lighting: Within the screen footage: explosive, erratic flashes of light from sparks and tearing metal, contrasted with deep, oppressive shadows. The screen itself emits a cold light.
shots.vfx_notes: Screen insert: Train derailing footage. This will be a VFX sequence (CG train or manipulated stock footage) composited onto the camera screen. Ensure it looks like security camera footage.
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic extreme close-up, eye-level shot with shaky handheld feel, focused entirely on the old digital camera screen. The screen is filled with raw, chaotic, and violently disturbing footage of a train derailing. Metal screeches, sparks erupt, and carriages flip and crash. The video has a grainy, low-res, security camera aesthetic. Gritty realism, visceral horror, intense chaos.

shots.lighting: The harsh station lights illuminate her desperate flight, casting dramatic shadows. The moving train's lights briefly sweep over her.

Gritty realism, intense physical urgency and terror.
